candidate.answerReason: Successive discounts retain 80% and then 85% of the current price, giving 0.80×0.85=0.68 of the original price.

methods.label: Apply each discount to the current price
methods.explanation:
The second discount applies to the price remaining after the first discount. A \(20\%\) discount leaves \(80\%\) of the price, and the following \(15\%\) discount leaves \(85\%\) of that reduced price. Thus the retained fraction of the original price is
\[
0.80\cdot0.85=0.68.
\]
The sale price is \(68\%\) of \(\$250\), namely \(250\cdot0.68=\$170\), choice D.
methods.levelReason: The solution uses elementary percentages and decimal multiplication.

candidate.annotationRationale: The target is interpreting and applying successive discounts. Finding a percentage of a number and multiplying decimal retention factors are the supporting procedures actually used.
